title: Video scripts and productions
summary: Create, read, update, rename, and configure sequencing for content-library groups and items, create grounded scripts and Agent-interface MP4 productions, or add a completed generated video to a sequence.

batch.reason: One script snapshots one exact selected interaction set and provenance chain.
One script read includes its exact source requests, version, and latest render state.

update.reason: Source-grounded scripts are immutable snapshots; a changed script is created as a new provenance-bearing resource.

delete.reason: Source-grounded scripts and render history are retained as provenance-bearing artifacts.

batch.reason: Group creation resolves one case-insensitive name and sequence-mode identity.
Rename preserves one exact group's identity, ordering, and membership.
Archiving requires one exact empty group and preserves its stable history.

delete.note: Delete is represented by the obsolete or unused retained lifecycle status.

resources.title: Video script source
resources.summary: An ordered immutable activity-event source captured by a generated video script.
resources.reason: Script creation owns immutable source provenance; later CRUD must not rewrite it.
